incidents.cause: A total loss of engine power for reasons that could not be determined based on the available evidence.
The pilot’s improper landing flare, which resulted in a bounced landing and subsequent nose landing gear collapse.
A total loss of engine power due to fuel exhaustion as a result of the pilot’s inadequate preflight inspection.
The pilot's failure to maintain an adequate visual lookout while taxiing.
The flight instructor’s inadequate preflight inspection of the fuel level, which resulted in a total loss of engine power due to fuel exhaustion.
The failure of the No. 2 cylinder exhaust valve resulting in a loss of engine power.
